name: Joan Herrington

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married John Yonges (license 24 July 1622: John Yonges, bachelor, and Joan Herrington of Southwold, spinster; bond by Mr. Christopher Yongs)

bioAdditions: Youngs Family (1907) gives the 1622 marriage and license, and suggests she may have been a daughter of the Stephen Herrington named in Thomas Warren's will. She died in England about 1630 (S1). Not ancestral on present evidence.

sources.citation: Selah Youngs Jr., Youngs Family: Vicar Christopher Yonges, his ancestors in England and his descendants in America (1907), pp. 38-41 (First and Second Generations)

researchLogEntry: Round 4: marriage and license detail from Youngs 1907; not ancestral.
